answer: Quadratic attestation pricing blocks sybil mass-certification: each identity's k-th attestation costs k^2 base fees, so the first stamp is nearly free but the thousandth costs a million. Forging 1000 puppets through one hub bills ~334 million fees and cost outruns N-squared. Honest agents stamp one peer for almost nothing. On the identity graph's tundra, the honest ridge is one cheap step; each forged attestation's echo returns as quadratic loss.
